2116937748791894332.en_summary: Trung T. Phan notes the pest control industry is worth $29B. Largest 2 firms (Rollins, Rentokil Terminix) account for 50% of revenue among top 100 pest control firms in US. Market cap for both are down between 20-40% this year. One reason: people using AI chatbots for pest control recommendations, and are being offered local options (while these global brands get hammered with bad reviews on Reddit).
2116937748791894332.zh_summary: Trung T. Phan 指出害蟲防治行業價值 290 億美元。最大兩家公司（Rollins、Rentokil Terminix）佔美國前 100 家害蟲防治公司收入的 50%。兩家市值今年下跌 20-40%。一個原因：人們使用 AI 聊天機器人獲取害蟲防治建議，並被提供本地選項（而這些全球品牌在 Reddit 上受到差評衝擊）。

ticker_notes.ROL: Pest control industry $29B; Rollins and Rentokil account for 50% of top 100 revenue; market caps down 20-40% this year partly due to AI chatbots favoring local options

2116926072176472091.en_summary: Sawyer Merritt finds himself getting more and more bullish on SpaceX by the week. The technologies they've developed, the rapid pace of deployment, and their manufacturing capabilities are so far ahead that it's actually wild the company is 'only' at a $1.8T market cap. If Elon's predictions for compute deployments and revenue growth actually materialize next year and beyond, SpaceX is extremely undervalued right now. Even if Elon is off by 50% on the low end of his projected $500B–$1T annualized revenue run rate by the end of 2027, that would still mean $250B. Pretty damn good. And this is all before next-gen Starlink Mobile and orbital compute really get going.
2116926072176472091.zh_summary: Sawyer Merritt 發現自己每週對 SpaceX 越來越看好。他們開發的技術、快速部署速度和製造能力遠遠領先，公司「只有」1.8 萬億美元市值實際上很瘋狂。如果 Elon 對運算部署和收入增長的預測明年及以後實現，SpaceX 現在極度低估。即使 Elon 對到 2027 年底年化收入運行率 5000 億至 1 萬億美元的低端預測偏差 50%，仍意味著 2500 億美元。相當不錯。而這一切還在下一代 Starlink Mobile 和軌道運算真正啟動之前。

ticker_notes.SPCX: Bullish; technologies and manufacturing far ahead; $1.8T market cap undervalued if revenue reaches even $250B by end 2027 per Elon projections
